title: 第19章 真气第20章 加强版大力丸
content_zh:
“这位少年，我看你根骨不凡，有人中龙凤之相……”
李半仙话还没说完，眼前的少年已经跑没影了。
唉，真是世风日下，人心不古啊，我话还没说完，你怎么就走了？
李半仙又有十几天没开张了，现在的人又穷又精，还死抠，越来越难骗了。
经历了社会的毒打，他才深刻体会到，二狗这小子，真是个好孩子，尊师重道好忽悠。
就在心中念叨二狗子的好时，就看到二狗子正向他的摊位走来，手上还提着一块猪肉。
李半仙连忙正身端坐，目不斜视，好一副道貌岸然。
“师父！”
“唉，你来啦！”
李半仙不动声色地接过二狗子手里的肥膘肉，不悲不喜，淡泊宁静。
“你最近修为进展如何？”
“我能感气了！”
二狗子喜形于色，李半仙却愣了一下，才想起功法中确有感气一说。
只是他本人连入门都没能练成，一直怀疑功法是假的，没有太在意后面的内容。
现在二狗子说练到感气，他仍然是半信半疑。
一本前人杜撰的假功法，自己练了好几年亲身证明过的，该不会真被这傻小子练成了吧？
“你如何感气的？说来给为师听听？”
“我昨晚上做了个梦，梦见娶媳妇……”
“这些细枝末节不必说！”
李半仙对那些少年人的春梦没什么兴趣，直入主题。

“就是今早起来，发现能感应到天地灵气了，空气中漂着许多小光点……”
二狗子将自己感受到的灵气都跟师父描述了一遍。
只略去了跟黄皮葫芦相关的信息。
李半仙揪着自己的胡子，陷入了深深的纠结和自我怀疑之中。
也许是情绪太过激动，胡子都被揪掉了几十根，他是一点也没察觉到。
过了一会，才平息了情绪，恬静淡然地说道：
“不错，不错！”
“但你仍然要戒骄戒躁，切勿骄傲自满，须知人外有人，天外有天！”
无论二狗子讲的是真是假，李半仙打定主意，还是要打压一下，不然以后就不好忽悠了。
“这一块小石头，你将它捏碎试一下。”
二狗子拿起桌上的石头，两只手使劲捏住，使出吃奶的劲，脸涨得通红，石头纹丝不动。
“师父，我捏不烂！”
二狗子摇了摇头，放弃了。
“所以你还得努力。”
content_en:
"This young man, I think you have extraordinary abilities, and you are like a dragon or a phoenix..."
Before Li Banxian finished speaking, the young man in front of him had already disappeared.
Alas, the world is really in decline, and people's hearts are not as old as they used to be. Why did you leave before I finished speaking?
Li Banxian hasn't opened for more than ten days. Nowadays, people are poor, smart and stingy, making it increasingly difficult to deceive.
After experiencing severe beatings from society, he realized deeply that Ergou was such a good boy, he respected his teachers and was easy to fool.
Just when he was thinking about Er Gouzi's good fortune, he saw Er Gouzi walking towards his stall, holding a piece of pork in his hand.
Li Banxian quickly sat upright without squinting his eyes, looking very sanctimonious.
"Master!"
"Oh, you're here!"
Li Banxian calmly took the fat meat from Er Gouzi's hand, neither sad nor happy, indifferent and peaceful.
"How is your recent progress in cultivation?"
"I can feel anger!"
Ergouzi was overjoyed, but Li Banxian was stunned for a moment before he remembered that there was indeed a sense of qi in the technique.
It's just that he himself couldn't even get started. He always suspected that the technique was fake and didn't pay much attention to the content behind it.
Now Ergouzi said that he had practiced to feel Qi, but he was still dubious.
This is a fake Kung Fu method invented by the predecessors. I have practiced it for several years and proved it myself. Could it be that this stupid boy really mastered it?
"How do you sense Qi? Can you tell me, Master?"
"I had a dream last night about marrying a wife..."
"No need to talk about these little details!"
Li Banxian was not interested in those young people's erotic dreams and went straight to the point.
"When I woke up this morning, I found that I could sense the aura of heaven and earth, and there were many small light spots floating in the air..."
Ergouzi described all the spiritual energy he felt to his master.
Only the information related to yellow-skinned gourds has been omitted.
Li Banxian grabbed his beard and fell into deep entanglement and self-doubt.
Maybe he was too excited, and dozens of strands of his beard were pulled out, but he didn't notice it at all.
After a while, he calmed down and said calmly:
"Not bad, not bad!"
"But you still have to guard against arrogance and impatience, and don't be arrogant and complacent. You must know that there are people outside the world, and there is a sky outside the sky!"
Regardless of whether what Er Gouzi said was true or false, Li Banxian made up his mind to suppress it, otherwise it would be difficult to deceive him in the future.
"Crush this small stone and try it."
Ergouzi picked up the stone on the table and squeezed it hard with both hands. His face turned red and the stone did not move at all.
"Master, I can't crush it!"
Ergouzi shook his head and gave up.
"So you still have to work hard."
